spans.s:
m. (-नः)
1 The ocean.
2 A male river.
f. (-ना)
A river.
E.
धे to drink, Uṇādi affix न; what is drunk.

f. (-नुः)
A milch cow, one that has lately calved.
E.
धे to drink, Uṇādi affix नु.

m. (-कः)
The name of an Asura or demon, killed by KṚṢṆA.
f. (-का)
1 A she-elephant.
2 A milch cow.
E.
धेनु a cow, and कन् aff.

m. (-नः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
धेनुक a demon, so called, and सूदन the destroyer; also similar compounds, as धेनुकहन्, धेनुकारि, &c.

n. (-ग्धं)
1 Cow's milk.
2 A plant: see चिर्भिट.
E.
धेनुका, and दुग्ध milk.

A small tree, Nagesara.
E.
धेनुक, and अरि a foe.

f. (-ष्या)
A cow at the dairy or tied up to be milked.
E.
धेनु a milch cow, यत् affix, and षुक् augment.
